name: OpenBeken temperature
description: A temperature channel (channel type Temperature, Temperature_div10 or _div100) as a temperature sensor: <client>/<channel>/get divided by the type's divisor.

client.label: Client topic
client.description: OpenBeken → Config → MQTT → Client Topic (Base Topic): the first level of its topics

divisor.label: Divisor
divisor.description: 1 for Temperature, 10 for Temperature_div10, 100 for Temperature_div100
